integrity: All new derivations are explicitly distinguished from classic Ville/Doob martingale bounds and the zero-overshoot criterion. The proof is analytic and the reproducibility program makes finite supplementary checks only. Historical novelty remains subject to independent review.
limitations: Exact two-row, noiseless, real, consistent randomized Kaczmarz; normalized independent rows sampled uniformly with replacement; one prescribed initial error. The exact-time-uniform bound is normalized by the instance-specific conditional-mean rate, not the paper's global spectral-norm contraction rate. Only infinite-horizon crossing probabilities are classified; no algorithm-wide or higher-dimensional optimality is claimed.
title: Exact Ville-bound equality angles for two-row randomized Kaczmarz
